Name: BetterBuildingUpgrades
Author: Nookick
Description:
[size=3][b][i][b]Introduction [English/Chinese][/b]
[/i][/b][/size][i]Ever feel like your farm buildings just can't keep up with your ambitions? Does your Greenhouse feel cramped long before you're ready to stop planting? Are you tired of sacrificing precious farm space to build rows of Silos just to feed your animals? Does the Well feel like little more than a decoration?

If you've found yourself nodding along, then this mod is for you! This mod introduces a growing list of upgrade options designed to enhance your buildings' capacity, efficiency, and functionality and etc, making your farm life smoother and more enjoyable.
[/i][list]
[*][b][i][size=3]New Upgrades:[/size][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]Greenhouse:[/i] [/b]
[/list][list=1]
[*][Large Greenhouse]: [i]Expands the interior of the greenhouse. Perfect for achieving crop self-sufficiency long before you reach Ginger Island.[/i] 
[color=#999999]500 Wood | 50 Hardwood | 20 Copper Bar[/color]
[*][Deluxe Greenhouse]: [i]This upgrade introduces a nighttime lighting system powered by solar panel to accelerate crop growth, adds a new dedicated area for artisan equipment like kegs and preserve jars, and provides even more farmland.[/i]
[color=#999999]30 Battery Pack | 100 Hardwood | 20 Iridium Bar[/color]
[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][b][i]Silo: [/i][/b]
[/list][list=1]
[*][Big Silo & Deluxe Silo]: [i]Upgrade your silos to hold significantly more hay. So you don't need to build a lot anymore[/i]
[color=#999999]200 Stone | 10 Clay | 5 Copper Bar; 350 Stone | 15 Clay | 20 Copper Bar[/color]
[*][Grinding Silo]: [i]Automatically grind hay into fine hay poder, which gives animal more happiness and friendship (you can take/store fine hay from Hay Hopper; store the Fine Hay into Silo; Animals now prefer fine hay instead of vanilla hay)[/i]
[color=#999999]400 Stone | 30 Iron Bar | 20 Copper Bar[/color][/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][i]Cellar: [/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*][Standalone Cellar]: A standalone cellar that allows you to age chess and wine
[color=#999999]300 Stone | 15 Iron Bar ﻿[/color]
[*][Big Standalone Cellar]: Expand the space of standalone cellar for more casks
[color=#999999]500 Stone | 25 Iron Bar | 20 Hardwood[/color][/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][i][b]Barn & Coop: [/b][/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*][Compost Barn & Compost Coop]: [i]Barn/Coop with a compost area that automatically produces quality fertilizer from animal waste.[/i]
[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][b][i]Well: [/i][/b]
[/list][list=1]
[*][Big Well]: [i]The upgraded well automatically waters nearby rice shoots, just like a pond, freeing you from the layout constraints of traditional rice paddies.[/i]
[color=#999999]200 Stone[/color]
[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][i][b][i]Stable[/i]: [/b][/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*][Big Stable]: [i]This cozy stable upgrade makes your horse run faster, saving you precious time on your journeys around Stardew Valley[/i]
[color=#999999]30 Hardwood | 5 Copper Bar[/color]
[/list][/list][list]
[*][i][b][size=3]Visuals:[/size][/b][/i]
[/list]﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/4wLvGJ8g/Mod-Visual.png[/img]
﻿﻿
[list]
[*][i][b][size=3]Installation Instructions: [/size][/b][/i]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] version [b]4.2.1[/b] or later.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.
[*]Launch the game and visit Robin to explore upgrades!
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make mod configuration easier.
[/list][/list][list]
[*][i][size=3][b]﻿﻿﻿Compatibility:[/b][/size][/i]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Frontier Farm larger greenhouse(need enable it in mod config menu)
[*]Currently not compatible with Build More Greenhouse
[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][size=3]etc[/size]
[/list][/list][size=3]
Feel free to share your ideas, I'll try to implement them[/size][size=3]
[url=https://github.com/Nook001/StardewValley-BetterBuildingUpgrades.git]Source Code[/url]


[size=3][i][b]简介[/b]
[/i][/size][i]你是否觉得原版的农场建筑总有些不尽如人意？温室的空间在作物和果树变多后显得捉襟见肘；为了饲养更多动物，不得不在农场上修建一排又一排的筒仓，占用了宝贵的土地；水井除了取水之外，几乎再无他用。

如果这些也是你的烦恼，那么这款Mod就是为你量身定做的！而解决这些常见的烦恼仅仅是一个开始。这款Mod引入了一系列不断丰富的升级选项，旨在提升建筑的容量、效率和功能性，让你的农场运营更加得心应手。

[/i][list]
[*][i][size=3][b]全新升级一览[/b]:[/size][/i]
[list]
[*][i][b]温室[/b][/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*][大型温室]: [i]扩展温室的内部空间，获得更多可耕种的土地和果树区域。在解锁姜岛之前，也能轻松实现作物自由！[/i]
[color=#999999]500 木头 | 50 硬木 | 20 铜锭[/color]
[*][豪华温室]: [i]在大型温室的基础上再次升级！引入了夜间照明系统以加速作物生长；新增了专门用于放置小桶等工匠设备的区域；并提供了更多农田。[/i]
[color=#999999]30 电池 | 100 硬木 | 20 铱锭[/color]

[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][i][b]筒仓[/b][/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*][大型筒仓 & 豪华筒仓]：提供更大容量的筒仓，让你不用为筒仓占用的空间而烦恼
[color=#999999]200 石头 | 10 粘土 | 5 铜锭; 350 石头 | 15 粘土 | 20 铜锭[/color]
[*][研磨筒仓]：自动将干草研磨成精制精制干草粉，提升动物的好感度和友谊(筒仓内的干草自动转换为精制干草粉，可以通过干草漏斗存取；通过筒仓储存)
[color=#999999]400 石头 | 30 铁锭 | 20 铜锭

[/color][/list][/list][list]
[*][b][i]堆肥畜棚/鸡舍[/i][/b]
[/list][list=1]
[*][堆肥畜棚/鸡舍]：堆肥区自动将动物粪便转化为高级肥料
[/list][/size] ﻿[list]
[list]
[*][i][b]独立地窖[/b][/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*][独立地窖]：独立地窖，用于陈酿奶酪和酒
[*][大型独立地窖]：扩展地窖空间
[/list][/list][size=3][list]
[list=1]

[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][i][b]水井[/b][/i]
[/list][list=1]
[*][大型水井]：升级后的水井可以像其他水源一样自动灌溉周围的稻苗
[color=#999999]200 石头[/color]

[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][i][b]马厩[/b]:[/i] 
[/list][list=1]
[*][大型马厩]：为你的爱马升级一个更舒适的家！升级后的马厩能让你的马跑得更快，为你节省更多穿梭于鹈鹕镇和农场之间的时间。
[color=#999999]30 硬木 | 5 铜锭[/color]

[/list][/list]
[list]
[*][i][size=3][b]安装指引：[/b][/size][/i]
[list=1]
[*]下载并安装4.2.1或更新版本的 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]下载该mod并解压到游戏根目录的Mods文件夹中[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[*]启动游戏并在罗宾出查看升级
[*](可选) 安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ 来更好地配置游戏
[/list][/list][/size][url=https://github.com/Nook001/StardewValley-BetterBuildingUpgrades.git]源码[/url]
